QuestInfo.name: Elluel At Peace
QuestInfo.0: Unlike what Athena Pierce said of Elluel, the town looks quite pleasant. Ask Philius what happened.
QuestInfo.1: Philius said that the curse of the Black Mage was lifted long ago, and that Elluel has rebuilt since then. And lucky you, Mercedes is in town right now. It all sounds too good to be true... is it? Talk to Mercedes.
QuestInfo.2: You were finally able to talk to Mercedes again. Boy, it sure has been awhile.

0.0: The curse of the Black Mage? Oh goodness, we settled that bit of nastiness long ago. Elluel is doing better than ever. Our young queen Mercedes is even here right now, checking in on us. She's at the #rRoyal Chamber#k if you wish to meet her.

yes.0: I'm sure the queen will be most happy to see an old friend. The Royal Chambers are just ahead.

no.0: Is this your first time in Elluel? You should have a look around. I am proud to say it is the most beautiful town in the world.

1.0: Hello, dear friend! Goodness, it's been ages since we last met, hasn't it? How have you been? Tell me all about your adventures...
